country.match: Match each volcano to its country.
country.odd: Three of these volcanoes are in {value}. Which one isn't?

rows.label: Mount Kilimanjaro
rows.description: mountain massif in Kilimanjaro National Park in Tanzania
rows.hook: is the tallest free-standing mountain in Africa, with snowy caps near the equator

rows.label: Mount St. Helens
rows.hook: blew off its own summit in a huge blast that flattened forests

rows.label: Mount Vesuvius
rows.description: active stratovolcano in the Gulf of Naples, Italy
rows.hook: buried the Roman town of Pompeii under ash and pumice

rows.label: Mount Fuji
rows.description: volcano in Yamanashi and Shizuoka Prefectures, Japan
rows.hook: is a snow-capped, near-perfect cone and the country's most iconic and sacred peak

rows.label: Mount Rainier
rows.description: stratovolcano in the U.S. state of Washington
rows.hook: is a heavily glaciated giant that looms over Seattle and Tacoma

rows.label: Mount Etna
rows.description: active stratovolcano on the east coast of Sicily, Italy
rows.hook: is Europe's tallest active volcano and erupts so often it is watched constantly

rows.label: Mount Ararat
rows.hook: is the traditional resting place of Noah's Ark in Biblical tradition

rows.label: Mauna Kea
rows.hook: is a dormant giant whose summit hosts a famous cluster of astronomical observatories

rows.label: Yellowstone volcano
rows.description: volcanic caldera in Yellowstone National Park in the United states
rows.hook: is a supervolcano whose caldera lies beneath geysers and hot springs like Old Faithful

rows.label: Tambora
rows.description: stratovolcano on the island of Sumbawa in Indonesia
rows.hook: produced the most powerful eruption in recorded history, causing a year without a summer

rows.label: Mauna Loa
rows.description: volcano on the island of Hawaii in Hawaii, United States
rows.hook: is the largest active volcano on Earth by volume

rows.label: Chimborazo
rows.description: volcano and highest mountain in Ecuador
rows.hook: has a summit that is the farthest point from Earth's centre, thanks to the equatorial bulge

rows.label: Kīlauea
rows.hook: has erupted almost continuously for decades and is home to the lava goddess Pele in legend

rows.label: Pinatubo
rows.description: active stratovolcano on the island of Luzon in the Philippines
rows.hook: erupted in one of the twentieth century's largest blasts, cooling the global climate

rows.label: Teide
rows.description: volcano on Tenerife in the Canary Islands
rows.hook: is the tallest peak on Spanish soil and rises above a national park of lava fields
